_meta.description: Analyst seat ratings that override the model's rating in the battleground view. Key each entry by assembly constituency number. `rating` is one of: safe, likely, lean, tossup. `bloc` is the bloc id the seat leans to (omit for tossup). `note` is shown on the seat. Leave a state's object empty to use the model alone.

20.note: Dhampur: won by 203 votes in 2022; local candidate factor.
